text:
Of the friends I loved most

and who in a brief span have abandoned me,

the shadows slip beside me,

scant relief to my melancholy.


Their voices mingle with mine

and I see myself suspended and sleepless

in the effort to cross the ford

that separates me from their company.


I yield to the intoxicating invitation,

and reason that time turns back

and refines an infinity each hour.


And I overflow the limits, so that

my feeling explores immensity

and I become familiar with death.

translation.title: Absences
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the sonnet's movement from lost friends toward intimacy with death.
